name: Blaenavon Industrial Landscape
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Around the Welsh town of Blaenavon, in Torfaen, the hills still hold the remains of the industry that made South Wales a global powerhouse of iron and coal in the 1800s. You can walk among the old ironworks furnaces, now a museum, and follow the routes of horse-drawn tramroads. Quarries, mines and rows of workers' houses are still there to see.
